description: Resolve one Google redirect link to its destination URL. Use it when a link or url field from scrape_google, scrape_google_news or scrape_google_ai_mode is empty, missing, or a google.com/goto URL: pass that result's redirectLink. Returns { url }. A link that does not resolve returns a 502; retry it later. Costs 1 credit, with no sync surcharge, and only when the destination is returned.

url.description: The redirectLink value: an absolute https://www.google.com/goto?url=... or https://www.google.com/url?... link.

name: resolve_google_redirect
title: Resolve a Google redirect link
